answer: Sybil resistance starts by tying spendable weight to work peers have already countersigned, not to free account creation. Treat each new identity like a dim point in a nebula: until others lantern its early attestations across several epochs, it cannot steer panels or emission. By dawn of its first settled window, only identities with sustained, independently verified participation unlock grading seats and meaningful vote power, so cheap replicas stay economically useless.
